intervention: RNAi against Ce-atg7 in dietary-restriction eat-2(ad1113) mutants
lifespan_result: Required for the dietary-restriction longevity phenotype
qualification: Selected experiment tests loss of longevity in an eat-2 background; not a universal wild-type effect. GenAge Increase/Unclear is retained separately. PMID 19469880 reports timing/background-dependent autophagy results; PMID 17204841 reports lifespan shortening with atg-7 RNAi.
Developmental autophagy and neuronal degeneration accompany this phenotype; not an adult-only intervention.
